name: SCIENCE TALK: Glass: From Volcanic Rock to Optical Fiber - Anthony Graham

It appears in windows and drinking glasses, but also in microscopes, telescopes, laboratory equipment, insulation, computer displays, batteries, fiber-optic networks, and countless engineered products. This talk explores what glass actually is, how humans learned to make it, why it has such unusual properties, and how modern science has transformed it into a highly engineered material. We will begin by exploring natural glasses and what distinguishes glass from crystalline materials.
